about.beta_body: This is an open-beta build (OB1.0.0). Features may still change or need a tweak on your side. Provided as-is — the author is not on the hook for lost data or unexpected downtime. Keep backups, use sensible passwords, and look after your own host and network. Try it, break it kindly, and tell us what to improve.
about.bug_body: Tell me what exploded. Screenshots are pure gold.
about.changelog.api: REST API v1:Awọn aaye ipari-ifọwọsi bọtini labẹ awoṣe igbanilaaye kanna, fun iṣọpọ pẹlu ohunkohun miiran ti n ṣiṣẹ lori ilẹ rẹ.
about.changelog.assets: Iforukọsilẹ dukia pẹlu Awọn aami Ti ara:Kikun OEM/atilẹyin/awọn igbasilẹ igbesi aye, pẹlu QR & DataMatrix aami titẹ sita — awọn sisanwo aisinipo fun Zebra tabi eyikeyi itẹwe iwe, ko si intanẹẹti nilo.
about.changelog.design: Eto Apẹrẹ Iṣọkan:Wiwo-iwakọ ami-ami kan kọja gbogbo module - ọrọ itansan AA, modal kan / bọtini / idile baaji, Imọlẹ otitọ / Dudu, ati ipilẹ WebGL kan ti o le wa ni pipa lori awọn ẹrọ agbalagba.
about.changelog.inventory: Oja pẹlu Leja Gidi:Gbogbo gbigbe - lilo tikẹti, lilo aṣẹ-iṣẹ, PO gbigba - ti wa ni igbasilẹ ati itopase pada si iṣẹ ti o fa.
about.changelog.notif: Awọn iwifunni & itọpa iṣayẹwo:Awọn itaniji olumulo-kọọkan fun awọn ifọwọsi, ọja kekere ati iṣẹ ti o pẹ, pẹlu akọọlẹ iṣayẹwo alaileyipada lẹhin wọn.
about.changelog.procurement: Ijaja, Ipari si Ipari:Ibeere → ifọwọsi idiyele → imuse olutọju ile itaja → gbigba awọn ọja → ilaja isuna, pẹlu olutẹpa ipele mẹsan ati itan-akọọlẹ ipo kikun.
about.changelog.rbac: Granular RBAC: 24 permissions across 6 editable roles, enforced server-side on every page and API endpoint — including separate tooling rights and a Storekeeper who can fulfil orders but never approve their cost.
about.changelog.reorder: Atunse Aifọwọyi-Iwakọ Iṣẹlẹ:Lilo ti o ju apakan kan silẹ si o kere julọ gbe ibeere kan dide laifọwọyi, nipasẹ awọn ofin ifọwọsi kanna bi afọwọṣe kan.
about.changelog.security: Ni lile nipasẹ Aiyipada:CSRF lori awọn iyipada ipinlẹ, awọn alaye ti a pese silẹ jakejado, imuduro igba ati awọn aabo ipa-ipa, ati Evil Maid titii mimu mimu ati isunmọ si olumulo ti o jẹri.
about.changelog.tickets: Igbesi aye Tiketi pipe:Forukọsilẹ → takeover → awọn iṣe ti a wọle → isunmọ → itan-akọọlẹ wiwa, pẹlu akoko ti o mu ni gbogbo igbesẹ ki MTTA ati MTTR jẹ iwọn, kii ṣe iṣiro.
about.changelog.ux: Ẹrọ-mọ UX:Ipo amusowo mu ṣiṣẹ laifọwọyi - awọn tabili ṣubu sinu awọn kaadi, kalẹnda di ero, ati awọn ibi-ifọwọkan dagba si iwọn ibọwọ itaja.
about.changelog.wo: Awọn aṣẹ Iṣẹ & Itọju Idena:Awọn iṣeto loorekoore, awọn iwe ayẹwo atunlo, wiwo kalẹnda, ati wiwa ti pẹ ti o da ohun ti o yọ.
about.chat_body: Ideas, questions, or plant-floor war stories — all welcome.
about.feat.analytics: Akoko gidi KPI & MTTR Awọn itupalẹ
about.feat.analytics_body: Ṣe akojọpọ telemetry ilowosi aise lati ṣe iṣiro Aago Itumọ Lati Tunṣe MTTR, ṣe atẹle akoko isunmi, ṣe abojuto fifuye iṣẹ onimọ-ẹrọ, ati foju inu agbara awọn ẹya lori akoko.
about.feat.assets_body: Ṣe itọju ipilẹ CMMS ipilẹ nkankan nipasẹ ilana-itọkasi ti ara ẹni. Awọn ẹrọ ati awọn apejọ ipin ti wa ni asopọ taara si awọn ẹya apoju wọn nipasẹ ipa ọna Bill of Materials BOM.
about.feat.docs_body: Ni aabo, ibi ipamọ iyasọtọ fun Awọn SOPs Aabo, Awọn afọwọṣe Imọ-ẹrọ, ati Awọn atẹjade buluu. Imudaniloju iru MIMEpipe ati ipa ọna iwe ti o ya sọtọ lati ṣe iṣeduro awọn iwe aṣẹ pataki-ailewu nigbagbogbo wa taara lati oju-iwe dukia.
about.feat.inventory_body: Tọpinpin data eekaderi ni kikun, awọn ipele iṣura, ati awọn aaye ibamu. Ṣe ẹya eto atunto aifọwọyi-odo ti o nfa nigbati ọja ba ṣubu ni isalẹ awọn ala ti a ti pinnu.
about.feat.lines: Awọn laini iṣelọpọ & Itaja Floor Ile Itaja
about.feat.lines_body: Idanileko ni kikun-si-ila-si-ẹrọ iṣakoso logalomomoise. Awọn laini iṣelọpọ jẹ awọn ara ilu akọkọ-akọkọ pẹlu awọn iṣiro ẹrọ, ipasẹ ipo, ati iṣọpọ taara sinu awọn aṣẹ iṣẹ ati ohun elo.
about.feat.modular_body: Atunto pipe sinu awọn folda agbegbe ọgbọn (_mgmt, _maint, _eam, _prod, _logi, _rpt ati bẹbẹ lọ) fun iduroṣinṣin ati imugboroja ọjọ iwaju. Gbogbo awọn itọkasi, pẹlu, ati imudojuiwọn lilọ kiri.
about.feat.pm_body: Ẹnjini ṣiṣeto ṣiṣeto fun Itọju Idena PM. Ṣe atẹle awọn ipa ọna ti o ti kọja ni adaṣe, ni agbara lati ṣatunṣe si awọn isinmi ọgbin, ati wiwo awọn ẹru iṣẹ lori kalẹnda ibaraenisepo.
about.feat.procurement_body: Ipoidojuko ni kikun akomora pq. Awọn ibeere rira Inu (PRs) dagba si Awọn aṣẹ rira ni deede (POs) ti a fi ranṣẹ si awọn olutaja, titọju iwe-iṣayẹwo IATF ti o ni ifaramọ kọja awọn ipo 9 pato PO.
about.feat.rbac: Iṣakoso Wiwọle ti O Da lori ipa RBAC
about.feat.rbac_body: Eto igbanilaaye ite ile-iṣẹ n wa aabo pipe. Lati iraye si module granular si Evil Maid Idaabobo ni idinamọ jija igba laigba aṣẹ lakoko gbigba tikẹti ati awọn isunmọ.
about.feat.tickets: Igbesi aye Tikẹti ni kikun (Ṣi si pipade)
about.feat.tickets_body: Ṣakoso awọn aṣiṣe ile-iṣẹ lati iforukọsilẹ akọkọ si iṣẹ iyansilẹ onimọ-ẹrọ ati ipinnu ikẹhin. Ṣe atilẹyin titẹsi taara fun awọn atunṣe ti a tọpa ni iyara.
about.indykb_blurb: Ipilẹṣẹ fun awọn onimọ-ẹrọ pinpin imọ laarin awọn ipo wa, ati larọwọto wa si ẹnikẹni ni kariaye ti o nilo lati jẹ ki awọn laini iṣelọpọ wọn lọ.

about.privacy_body: WCC is built for local / on-prem installs. It does not phone home, and it does not collect your plant data for anyone else. Tickets, assets, users, and files live in your database on your host. How safe that is depends on your own network, firewall, accounts, and backups — not on a cloud we control, because there isn’t one.
about.privacy_title: Runs on your machine — your data stays yours
about.release_intro: Open beta OB1.0.0 — the modules below are built, wired end to end, and exercised on plant-style data. Expect polish as the beta matures.
about.welcome: Kaabọ si Ile-iṣẹ Iṣakoso Idanileko WCC. Eyi kii ṣe nkan miiran ti o gbin ti sọfitiwia ile-iṣẹ ti a ṣe apẹrẹ ni yara igbimọ-o jẹ iṣẹ ṣiṣe giga kan, ⟦CMMS ti ko ni ilana ti a da ni taara lori ilẹ ile-iṣẹ. Ti a ṣe nipasẹ awọn onimọ-ẹrọ ati awọn onimọ-ẹrọ, FUN awọn onimọ-ẹrọ ati awọn onimọ-ẹrọ, WCC yọkuro iwuwo iku ile-iṣẹ lati jiṣẹ ohun ti o ṣe pataki gaan:iyara ipaniyan pipe. Ti a ṣe apẹrẹ lati ṣiṣẹ ni eti, o fọ ẹnu-bode alaye, fifi awọn irinṣẹ lati ṣakoso igbesi aye tikẹti pipe, tọpinpin akojo oja pataki, ati itupalẹ awọn KPI akoko gidi taara si ọwọ rẹ.
